reviews.text:
After reading the reviews from the Salpêtrière University Hospital, your rabbits brought a smile back to my face.
Thank you.
Great advice, thank you!

Thank you for your flexibility; you were a lifesaver for us with a last-minute request outside of your business hours!
Looking forward to working with you again :)

We stopped by on our way to PereLachaise. At first it appeared a little small, and cramped. We wanted to get something for our cat to stop vomiting fur ball every single day or every time she eats. The owner gave us a tube of cat malt, salmon flavor, and made in France! A life changer for our cat which has not stopped vomiting for the last 14 years. In the last 6 weeks, my cat only vomited once! And the large tube was only 8 euros. We are thrilled.

I bought a 3kg bag of Purina pet food and a pack of wipes: over €50 in total, whereas online the food costs around €20 and the wipes less than €10. The high prices are bordering on exorbitant. The only advantage is that the store stays open late, which can be useful in a pinch. If you're not in a hurry, avoid this shop.
The person's welcome was especially kind, but I didn't find what I was looking for. 😒 …
Excellent experience, I highly recommend it!
Amazing kibble and lovely staff!
The staff are very friendly, Kristina is a gem, I recommend her 100%!
Excellent shop! The salesperson gives wonderful advice!

It's unbearable when shops don't open on time. After waiting 30 minutes, I left. What's the point of having opening hours on the door if they're not respected, and a phone number that no one answers? 😡 …
I received good advice in this store.

A very bad experience at this pet shop. I went in to buy a hamster, but the salesperson refused to sell it to me because I didn't have a picture of my cage with me. However, he quickly tried to sell me his own cage and all the necessary equipment.

He also mentioned that hamsters can have heart attacks, which seemed presented in a rather alarming way, rather than as genuine advice on how to properly care for the animal.

I completely understand that a pet shop wants to ensure that an animal will be well cared for, but the way they approached it gave me the impression of a hard sell rather than genuine guidance. A disappointing experience; I won't be going back.

I went there without doing any research, but I should have. It was a disgrace: birds hidden away in a tiny room, in tiny aviaries. One had damaged feathers, and none of the birds were calling out (as a happy, healthy bird would).

The room was far too hot; these animals have no business being there. Please, buy your pet products elsewhere, and better yet, don't buy animals at all. I left that place as quickly as I arrived, without even saying goodbye. I refuse to support this garbage.
It annoyed me, I wanted to buy leashes for my dog ​​but the seller hit me and said, "Your mother's a female dog!"

I was very disappointed with my experience at City Pet Shop.

I regret their lack of flexibility, understanding, and consideration for animal welfare.

What worries me most is the issue of animal welfare. When a customer honestly explains that they won't be able to properly care for an animal, it seems more responsible to prioritize the animal's well-being rather than insisting on making the sale at all costs.
Great store, friendly professionals and good advice. Quality French products.

Fantastic welcome and excellent advice!

I came to buy supplies for my guinea pigs, both food and equipment, and I received excellent service. The person who helped me was lovely, attentive, and very professional. She took the time to answer all my questions and guide me towards the products best suited to my needs. Truly pleasant service and invaluable advice. I recommend this store without hesitation! 😊
A very pleasant shop, lots of choice and all of it high quality. My cat is a picky eater, so I always find something to please him! I always receive excellent service! I highly recommend it.

A well-stocked shop with a huge selection of pet supplies.
I fell in love with a rabbit, and the sales assistant took the time to explain the entire purchase process and advise me on food and its care. Excellent service and advice; I highly recommend it.
Best pet shop, top-notch service! The staff are very friendly and give excellent advice, and I'll definitely be back!! I highly recommend this pet shop; you can trust them.
Plenty of pallets on Monday, wonderful kibble on Tuesday, and always a team ready to take great care of us and advise us on how to take care of our four-legged companions!
My mother, sister, and I stopped by to inquire about adopting a rabbit. The saleswoman was lovely, very patient, and gave us excellent advice. Thank you for the warm welcome! 🌷 …
This is where I got my little chinchilla Kiwi, who is one year old. A little grey male. I'm very happy.

I've been to this shop several times and have always had good experiences, especially with the manager, whom I know and who is very pleasant.

Today, I came to compare cat litters and took some photos to help me choose, particularly for comparison.

I was practically attacked by the saleswoman, in a very cold manner, who told me I wasn't allowed to take photos.

I can completely understand the rule, but there's a way to say it and a way to do it. In this case, the way she did it was truly inappropriate and shocking.

It's all the more unfortunate because the shop itself is nice.

I'm giving it 3/5 because I'm comparing it to my previous experiences, but this kind of service is clearly unacceptable.

City Pet Shop is a family-run business that's definitely worth a visit. The team is incredibly friendly, attentive, and offers great advice. They have BARF food in a wide variety of flavors, so there's plenty of variety for our pets! And all at very reasonable prices. I highly recommend it! 🐱🐶 …
Nice shop and very helpful gentleman
The best shop in Azaz ❤️❤️

Opinions seem to differ; running a business isn't always perfect. I stopped by this store with some family from out of town, and they found what they needed and were satisfied. Since I don't remember the exact location, I'm writing this review for them.
A seller sold me a guinea pig that was sick and didn't know what it was doing; I don't recommend it.

I went to the store today to buy a guinea pig, but they sold it to me even though it was sick. It had ringworm, which can be transmitted between guinea pigs and even between humans. So I absolutely do not recommend this store. The staff was completely incompetent and didn't even tell me it was sick; they sold it to me without warning. And on top of that, the salesperson clearly didn't know what they did for a living, so I definitely do not recommend this shop.
The saleswoman was awful (I'm referring to the fake blonde), there were dead fish in the display cases, and no animals in stock. It's a shame, a beautiful shop, but with staff like that, it's a pity.
Caged birds! I'm running away.

Hi, it's Rebecca!
I'm so happy with my hamster purchase!
The service is amazing, I highly recommend it! ❤️❤️

⭐ Thank you for your review! ⭐ We are extremely pleased with your feedback. We are delighted to know you had a good experience.

We look forward to seeing you again soon.

The City Pet Shop Team
Great shops for rabbits

Excellent welcome, great selection, and helpful advice!

Kudos again to the team for the splendid Halloween decorations.

The saleswoman was incredibly unpleasant… I only asked for the prices because they weren't marked… the blonde woman spoke very rudely, or maybe she just didn't want to talk. She also gave you a really nasty look… I don't recommend it.

The saleswoman was extremely unpleasant (a blonde woman, I should mention, as other salespeople might be nicer), refusing to exchange a product still in its packaging, undoubtedly purchased in this shop, on the pretext that I didn't have the receipt. Such an outdated attitude (who keeps a receipt in 2025?), and so anti-customer. Lost customer.
The cats love it! Very friendly owners. 10 hours of opening time per day... what more can I say? The best!
Very nice shop, the salesperson was excellent and super professional. Thank you.
Great shop and excellent advice

Unpleasant staff.
The lady who greeted me was on her phone, didn't even say hello, nothing. Never again.
Well-stocked and very convenient that the shop stays open late!

I'm very happy with this store! You can find absolutely everything for your pets: quality food, toys, accessories, and even grooming products. The selection is vast, the prices are reasonable, and the advice is really helpful. I highly recommend it!
The advice was very thorough and helpful for animals; I received excellent guidance.

🌟 A real gem!

I loved discovering City Pet Shop: a well-run, pleasant shop with a truly relevant selection of pet products. But what makes all the difference is the owner: incredibly friendly, passionate, and above all, very welcoming. You can tell he loves what he does and knows his stuff—you immediately feel at ease, get great advice, and there's no pressure. A rare find that I wholeheartedly recommend. 🐾
Super

Great store with a very wide selection of products.
The staff are super friendly and welcoming. Always available to advise us on the best products.
I recommend it 100%.

Very friendly owners! I needed a dome and a lightbulb, and I found exactly what I needed! For those who keep reptiles, I recommend this pet shop; you'll find a variety of reptile supplies. I'm so glad I found this place!
Great pet shop with lots of gorgeous dog accessories, treats and toys.
Hello. My 10-year-old daughter called to ask if a rabbit was available for sale, and the saleswoman clearly laughed at her. The telephone reception needs improvement.
Very welcoming staff. Wide selection of Easy Barf trays.

Hello
I bought a yellow canary. It's very healthy and started singing on the first day.
My mother is very happy.

Thank you for your professionalism.
Francis
I buy raw food for my cat there. You have to call ahead to check what's in stock. The owner has always been friendly on the phone.
Top-notch shopkeeper 😊 …
Top-notch pet shop, very professional, the ladies who work there were very helpful and friendly! I highly recommend it!!

The place is tiny but well distributed to accommodate a pretty wide range of basic products.

Personal was welcoming and helpful.
It's a very good car wash.
Really nice, and who likes malous 😁 …
Exorbitant prices on frozen rodents. Tiny shop. I recommend La Ferme Tropicale in the 13th arrondissement instead.
Local pet shop in the Marais with quality product.
Loyal and always satisfied customers, with fair prices, an ideal home range for feeding our kitten, and wide opening hours.

Shop closed at 5:30 PM.
The opening hours are incorrect.
The saleswoman was not pleasant at all, not even a goodbye. I do not recommend her at all.
Lively fish, spotless tanks. I think I'll buy my betta from this shop!
Absolutely lovely and a great listener!
Very pleasant reception.
Great selection with adorable animals. The staff are very involved and offer excellent advice. They ensure the animals' well-being and proper care.
This is a very good pet store. They have a wide variety of pet supplies, including many well-known brands. The staff are very helpful and explain things in detail. They even have a very cute ferret!

Horrifying experience

In short: Animals in poor condition. Manager insults customers.

We went to this pet shop for the first time to see some birds.

There was a bird right in the middle of the aisle in the side room. The bird was extremely stressed and in poor condition (probably pecked).

I hadn't seen the "no photos" sign, and as a result, the manager verbally abused us, saying, "I'm going to break you in two."

Avoid at all costs!
I bought ActiPlant'3 Insect Repellent for my cat for €16.99, but I found it costs only €10 elsewhere. I do not recommend this store.
A decent selection for a small shop in the heart of Paris, and the location is convenient. …
Great advice! Very helpful
The saleswoman is very kind and gives excellent advice! Great shop! I recommend it.
Great product and good advice!

The best pet shop in Paris! I go there specifically to buy everything we need for our cat! Not only are the products top-notch, but the welcome is warm and friendly! Here I find advice for my cat without being pressured to buy anything! …
